name: The Glutton's Tale

{Team Unique}: The wielder's HP Recovery +[StateArg2]%.
At the start of each turn, gain Temporary {STR} and Shield equal to [StateArg1]% of the total amount of HP lost last turn.
lore:
<Bold:January 24>
I smell awful.
Today, while riding home with our housekeeper, Teresa, we passed through the South Hamp@1on District. It was not a pleasant experience.
It's a dangerous place. Some people there had strange wounds—triangular holes in their bodies.

Teresa said it was the Lord's punishment for heretics.

<Bold:February 22>
I've had a fever for a month.
Today, I finally managed to eat something: fresh steak, tender and juicy...
Yes, juicy.
Red, sweet, and delicious.
All the mirrors in the house have been removed, and even Bobby is afraid to look at me.

Hehe. They don't know that at night, I can still see my reflection in the shadowed window.
My face, neck, and chest—from top to bottom—are densely covered in black @2 triangles.

<Bold:March 17>
It feels as though a red veil has been draped over my eyes.
The world has turned the color of blood.

Father shouted at me from within the crimson mist. It was the first time he had ever spoken to me so loudly.
He was close, yet his voice sounded distant. I could smell despair, disgust, and blood.

No...@2... Please... take me away... No...
